items.prompt: You have recently met someone you like. Which communication pattern would feel most natural to you over the next week?

options.text: I would exchange frequent short messages during the day and leave deeper conversations for later.
I would communicate less often, but when we talk I would prefer longer and deeper conversations.
I would balance brief daily contact with an occasional longer conversation.
I would keep communication light and occasional until we know each other better.

items.prompt: When you have a free weekend, how do you usually prefer to arrange your social plans?

options.text: Having several different plans one after another tends to energize me.
One planned get-together and keeping the rest of the time for myself suits me better.
I prefer deciding who to see and what to do based on how I feel that day.
I mostly prefer my own space and may add a short social plan if I feel like it.

items.prompt: When planning a day together, which approach feels most natural to you?

options.text: I prefer settling the plan in advance and sticking to it as much as possible.
I like having a clear main plan while leaving room for small changes.
A rough idea is enough; I enjoy deciding the details during the day.
It feels more natural to decide most things at the last minute based on what we feel like doing.

items.prompt: Someone you have recently started getting close to asks you a personal question early on. Which response is closest to you?

options.text: If I feel comfortable, I answer openly and in detail.
I share part of it and leave the more personal parts until trust develops.
I can talk about it, but I prefer more time before sharing personal details.
I prefer keeping the conversation lighter and building closeness through shared experiences first.

items.prompt: When your messaging rhythm with someone close to you has been different from usual for a few days, what do you generally do?

options.text: I keep my usual communication rhythm and do not immediately read too much into the change.
I adjust how often I message to match their new rhythm.
At an appropriate time, I directly ask whether our communication rhythm is working for both of us.
I give the interaction some space to find its rhythm naturally again.

items.prompt: In a social setting where you feel comfortable, which pattern is usually closest to you?

options.text: I talk with many people but mostly keep the topics light.
I have longer conversations with fewer people and open up gradually.
I move between different people and may discuss personal topics when trust develops.
I observe the setting first and join one or two conversations once I feel comfortable.
